generate_natvis_file: run the script with --version flag to generate a nlohmann_json.natvis file in the output directory
generate_namespace_combinations: run the script to generate all combinations of inline namespace names for a given library version
validate_semver: use the semver function to validate that a version string matches the X.Y.Z format
render_jinja2_template: run the script to render the nlohmann_json.natvis.j2 template with generated namespace data
review_semver_validation: review the semver function to understand how it validates semantic version strings using regex
